Suspect(s) — No suspect identified.

Witness(es) — No witnesses reported.

## Narrative

On 2026-07-24 at approximately 07:00, Officer J. Rivera (badge 4471) responded to a reported residential burglary at 118 Maple St at 2nd Ave. Upon arrival the rear sliding door was observed to have been pried open and glass was on the kitchen floor (observed by responding officer). The resident, R. Osei, told the officer she had left the home secured at 22:00 the previous night (reported by resident). A silver laptop, valued at about $900, appears to be missing from the residence (reported by resident). The officer photographed the point of entry and canvassed two neighbors. No suspect has been identified and no witnesses were reported.

## Statements

Resident statement: R. Osei stated she left the home secured at 22:00 the night before.

Canvass: two neighbors were canvassed; no names or signed/recorded statements were provided.

## Property

- Silver laptop — quantity 1, est. value $900; status: reported stolen / not recovered; reported by resident R. Osei.

## Actions Taken

Secured the scene; photographed point of entry (rear sliding door); canvassed two neighbors. No physical evidence booked beyond scene photographs.

None.

Referred.
